Resolves #21472

The Tabs group had one card, a workbench whose three tabs rendered nothing. It now opens on **Browser-Style Tabs** (`examples/tab/browser`): thirty closable tabs in one strip, a "+" header action that opens and activates one more, drag to reorder, and the `Overflow` plugin's menu for the tabs that do not fit, whose control sits beside the "+" as a header action. Every behaviour is a `Neo.tab.Container` config (`closable` headers, `headerActions`, `activateInsertedTabs`, `dragResortable`); the controller only answers "+". `tab/container` becomes a tile with content in each tab. The tile is in neomjs/pages#132; the cover with the matching header actions is in neomjs/pages#136.

Evidence: L3 (component, unit and e2e specs in CI; the cover and the tile captured twice to the same bytes; frames released and changed) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `component/tab/BrowserTabs.spec.mjs` checks that Playground, the 30th tab, is not in the strip, then picks it from the "More tabs" menu and sees it selected with its page shown. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `component/tab/BrowserTabs.spec.mjs`: "+" selects "New tab 1"; its × removes it and a remaining tab stays selected; a pointer drag moves Inbox behind Calendar; the overflow control and the "+" sit in the header with one size and background. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` (Tabs counts `[2, 0]`, the catalog order) and `unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` (the recipe and the tile validate). Outside-CI: the changed group page and the tile below; the images in neomjs/pages#132 and #136. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **`tab/container`'s cards rendered nothing:** `vdom: {html}` on these items never reached the DOM, which is why its tabs were empty on 18 Nov. They now use the `html` config and keep `tabIndex` through `vdom`.
- **Its badge tab is found by `flag`,** like its first tab; it was found by the text `'Tab 3'`, which a rename broke.
- **`captureExamples.mjs`:** a tile needs no recipe in a declared family, since `tabs` now holds `tab-container`. #21458 landed the same change on `dev`, so the file has left this diff.
- **The cover shows the opening strip, not one with a new tab.** After an insert with overflow active, the strip's active-tab indicator slides to a stale position and shows there briefly before it fades. Out of scope, noted in defect-note `a23da6e4`.
- **The browser tabs open on the dark theme** (`neo-theme-neo-dark` first), and their recipe declares `theme: 'dark'`, so the cover follows #21140 Design 7 ("every cover and crop is taken in the dark theme"). Commit `e741c624c4`; Euclid's review of #21468 caught the same rule there.
- **`seo.json`** takes the generator's entries: the group's description, the new page, and the tab container's `lastmod`.
- **The tile reads at catalog size** (Euclid's review RA-1, commit `cd420372ec`). The tile captures the component at 264 × 176, the narrowest size that keeps all three tabs, the badge and the next arrow out of the overflow menu. Its region is now 312 CSS px instead of 408. The record is named "Tab container", like the other component tiles.
- **The overflow control sits beside the "+" as a header action** (operator report, 19 Nov). The plugin's default control floats on `document.body`, outside the header toolbar, so it rendered as a filled default button (39 × 32, blue) beside the plain "+" (24 × 24). `projectAsAction`, which the plugin documents for "composed headers that already own an action rail", puts it in the rail: both now measure 24 × 24 with the same background. Commit `a938add320`; the cover is re-captured in neomjs/pages#136.

## Cold look

Two readers without this session's context graded the unlabelled frames from 1 to 10 (how well a newcomer understands within ten seconds what the page shows and what to do), the second reader with the order swapped:

| | Reader 1 (released shown first) | Reader 2 (changed shown first) |
|---|---|---|
| Group page, released → changed, 1440 | 5 → 8 | 4 → 8 |
| `examples/tab/container`, released → changed | 5 → 7 | 6 → 8 |
| `examples/tab/browser` (new), 1440 | 8 | 8 |

Both read the browser tabs from the opening line (drag, ×, "+", the overflow menu) and the tab container from its new tab content. What they missed: the "+" sits small at the strip's right end, the overflow button shows no count, and below the strip the page is mostly empty. In the tab container, the inspector clips its last flag (`dragResortable`), and the code box shows only `module: Neo.tab.Container`, which D#21480 takes up. On the group page, the tab container's tile did not read at its size. The readers graded the 360 × 200 tile, and the re-framed tile in the last frame row answers that.
